name: Dream Dreamer
source:
There is a legend that sleeping with a thought of beloved person while holding a "dream stone" can bring happiness. Main character puts such stone into his bracelet. Can he meet his fateful person?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一个传说，抱着“梦石”，想着心爱的人入睡，可以带来幸福。主角将这样的石头放入他的手镯中。他能遇见他的命中注定的人吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
